lines.en: label yumispecial40p2:
scene clearnightsky

I make my way out of the convenience store and try to spy on Yuki out of the corner of my eye- thinking that maybe she was just waiting for me to be gone to let her guard down and start crying or something.
lines.zh: 我走出便利店，试着用眼角余光偷看 Yuki——想着也许她只是在等我走了才卸下防备，开始哭什么的。

lines.en: Of course, I’m unable to see anything.
lines.zh: 当然，我什么也没看到。

lines.en: Not just because she’s likely not robotic enough to cease functioning the second I’m out of her line of sight, but because mine is currently being flooded by an onslaught of street lights and neon.
lines.zh: 不只是因为她大概没机械到一离开我的视线就停止运作，更是因为我自己的视线此刻正被铺天盖地的路灯和霓虹淹没。

lines.en: Yumi.
lines.zh: Yumi。

lines.en: That’s what I should be thinking about right now- not whatever minor inconveniences I’m stuck dwelling on in an effort to make myself believe my problems are somehow bigger than hers.
lines.zh: 这才是我现在该想的事——而不是陷在那些微不足道的烦恼里，好让自己相信我的问题比她的更严重。

lines.en: After all, this is a rare opportunity for me to make a positive impact on someone’s life when they need it the most.
lines.zh: 毕竟，这是一个难得的机会，让我能在别人最需要的时候，对她的人生产生正面的影响。

lines.en: And oh, how excited I am to let that {s}slip{/i} fall through my fingers like the grains of sand I’m {i}still{/i} finding on my clothes and in my shoes all this time after the second beach trip.
lines.zh: 哦，我真「期待」自己像握不住沙粒一样让这个机会从指缝间溜走——就像第二次海滩之行过了这么久，我{i}还{/i}能在衣服上、鞋子里找到那些沙粒。

lines.en: If only I was able to bring something of value home with me rather than the useless remnants of something I never wanted to begin with.
lines.zh: 要是我能带点有价值的东西回家就好了，而不是我一开始就不想要的那些无用残余。

lines.en: Now, where did she run off to?
lines.zh: 那么，她跑哪儿去了？

lines.en: I look around and see plenty of other people.
lines.zh: 我环顾四周，看到不少其他人。

lines.en: And if this were one of those Korean dramas Ami watches all the time, I’m sure the first person I’d ask would know exactly which direction the girl I’m looking for ran off in.
lines.zh: 如果这是 Ami 天天看的那种韩剧，我敢肯定，我随便问的第一个人都会准确知道我在找的女孩往哪个方向跑了。

lines.en: Unfortunately, real life is scarcely that convenient- and I expect tonight to be full of failed chances at locating her amidst growing waves of uncertainty regarding whether or not I even {i}should.{/i}
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，现实生活很少这么方便——我预料今晚会在一波又一波「我到底该不{i}该{/i}找她」的犹疑中，一次又一次地错过。

lines.en: What can I do?
lines.zh: 我能做什么？

lines.en: Or rather, what {i}will{/i} I do?
lines.zh: 或者说，我{i}会{/i}做什么？

lines.en: Because those questions have two dramatically different answers, and the one that we’ll wind up observing together will likely be the one furthest from the right course of action.
lines.zh: 因为这两个问题的答案截然不同，而我们最终将一同见证的那个，大概会离正确做法最远。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: I guess I’ll just shrug-
lines.zh: 我想我只能耸耸肩——

lines.en: Slide my hands into my pockets-
lines.zh: 把手插进口袋——

lines.en: And venture off in whatever general direction my gut points me in.
lines.zh: 然后顺着直觉指的大致方向走下去。

lines.en: It’s led me to her plenty of times in the past.
lines.zh: 过去它带我找到过她很多次。

lines.en: Here’s hoping it doesn’t stop cooperating now.
lines.zh: 但愿它现在别不配合。

lines.en: scene black
scene yumiwallpound1
Well, would you look at that?
lines.zh: 哟，你瞧瞧？

lines.en: There were barely any failures at all on the way here.
lines.zh: 这一路上几乎没走什么弯路。

lines.en: In fact, I think this is only the third or fourth alleyway I’ve had the displeasure of searching.
lines.zh: 事实上，我想这只是我不幸搜过的第三条或第四条小巷。

lines.en: And here she is in all of her miserable glory- pounding away at a cement wall, still wearing the gloves her mother ridiculed her for not removing just a short while ago.
lines.zh: 她就在这儿，浑身散发着悲惨的光辉——正一拳拳砸着水泥墙，手上还戴着刚才被她妈嘲笑没脱下来的那副手套。

lines.en: That’s good.
lines.zh: 这挺好。

lines.en: It might be awkward for all of us if I have to rush Yumi back to the convenience store for bandages only to find Yuki there, still caught up in a daze about where her life is heading.
lines.zh: 要是我得急着带 Yumi 回便利店找绷带，却发现 Yuki 还在那儿，为人生该往哪儿去发呆，那我们大家都会很尴尬。

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}
: Fuck!
: Fuck! Fuck! Fuck!
lines.zh: : 操！操！操！

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound2
: I know you’re there, asshole.
lines.zh: : 我知道你在那儿，混蛋。

lines.en: : Damn. I was a little interested in seeing if you’d be able to take down that wall or not.
lines.zh: : 可惜。我还挺想看看你能不能把那堵墙砸倒。

lines.en: : What gave my presence away?
lines.zh: : 你怎么发现我在的？

lines.en: : Probably the fact that my body instinctively tenses up any time you’re within ten feet of me.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为只要你进入我十英尺以内，我的身体就会本能地绷紧。

lines.en: : I’ll try and stay at least fifteen feet away the next time I have to chase you down an alley, then.
lines.zh: : 那下次我在小巷里追你的时候，会尽量保持至少十五英尺的距离。

lines.en: : How are your hands?
lines.zh: : 你的手怎么样？

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound3
: I don’t know. Cold?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。冷？

lines.en: : They hurt a little, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概是有点疼吧。

lines.en: : Not like I have anything else I can fuckin’ take my anger out on around here, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这附近也没有别的东西能让我撒气了。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound4
: And what the fuck were you doing with her?! I thought I told you to stop getting yourself involved with my fucking family!
lines.zh: : 还有你他妈跟她在一起干什么？！我不是说了别再跟我家里人扯上关系吗？！

lines.en: : I’m aware. I have a tendency to kind of just do what I want, though, so commands like that won’t ever really have any effect on me.
lines.zh: : 我知道。不过我这人有想干什么就干什么的毛病，所以那种命令对我基本没用。

lines.en: : You don’t fuckin’ say.
lines.zh: : 这还用说。

lines.en: : Since you’re being so polite, I guess I can let you know, though.
lines.zh: : 不过既然你这么客气，我就告诉你吧。

lines.en: : I was helping her pass out fliers for the bar she works at.
lines.zh: : 我在帮她发她上班那家酒吧的传单。

lines.en: : Probably so she can save up enough money for another present you can throw into Ayane’s pond.
lines.zh: : 大概是为了攒够钱，再买一份你可以扔进 Ayane 家池塘的礼物。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound5
: I don’t want her fucking {i}presents.{/i} I want my childhood back.
lines.zh: : 我不要她那些该死的{i}礼物{/i}。我想要回我的童年。

lines.en: : Let me know when she figures out how to fit that into a fucking box and I’ll think about maybe {i}not{/i} dumping it into the nearest body of water.
lines.zh: : 等她想出怎么把那玩意儿塞进一个该死的盒子里，记得告诉我，到时我再考虑要不要{i}不{/i}把它扔进最近的水里。

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to let you know.
lines.zh: : 我一定转告她。

lines.en: : Yeah. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 行。谢了。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound6
: So, how long are you planning on staying out here for?
lines.zh: : 那么，你打算在外面待多久？

lines.en: : In fact, why are you even all the way over here in the first place? We’re a long way from the dorms.
lines.zh: : 说起来，你大老远跑这儿来到底是为了什么？这儿离宿舍可远了。

lines.en: : So what? I’ve got legs. I know where the fuck I’m going.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？我有腿。我知道自己他妈在往哪儿走。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure the last time I saw you over here, you were in the heat of trying to evade our constant run-ins with one another. Don’t tell me that’s what-
lines.zh: : 我很确定上次在这儿见到你时，你正忙着躲开我们频繁的偶遇。别告诉我这次是——

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound7
: I was looking for a job, okay?!
lines.zh: : 我在找工作，行了吧？！

lines.en: : Without my help? I didn’t think you cared that much.
lines.zh: : 没有我帮忙？我还以为你没那么在乎呢。

lines.en: : Well, I do! And since nowhere near the fuckin’ dorms wants to hire me, it looks like I’ve got nowhere else to search but right smack dab in the heart of the fuckin’ city!
lines.zh: : 我在乎！而且宿舍附近没一家店肯雇我，看来我只能往这该死的市中心找了！

lines.en: : I really hope you weren’t planning on applying to that convenience store because I’m pretty sure you may have just ruined your chances.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你没打算申请那家便利店，因为我敢说你大概刚把自己的机会搞砸了。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound8
: Ha ha ha. You’re fucking hilarious. Now can you leave me alone for a few more minutes so I can finish crying?
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。你可真好笑。那你能不能再让我一个人待几分钟，好让我把眼泪哭完？

lines.en: : Feel like that’s all I’ve been fuckin’ doing lately.
lines.zh: : 感觉我最近他妈一直在干这事。

lines.en: : You know, it’s real weird how I went basically my whole life without crying until you started getting involved in it. Now, it’s like I can’t even do shit without realizing how fucked up and weak I am.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，真他妈奇怪，在你掺和进来之前，我基本上这辈子都没哭过。现在倒好，我做什么都能意识到自己有多扭曲、多软弱。

lines.en: : You should be thankful you met me now, then. That sort of thing would catch up to you after a while.
lines.zh: : 那你现在该庆幸遇见了我。那种东西迟早会找上你的。

lines.en: : And the longer you kept it held in, the worse it would be when it finally boils over.
lines.zh: : 而且憋得越久，最后爆发的时候就越糟。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound9
: I’d sure as fuck be fine with takin’ my chances. Can’t see how it would be any worse than trying to beat a fucking cement wall to death.
lines.zh: : 我他妈倒宁愿赌一把。我看不出那能比把一堵水泥墙打死更糟。

lines.en: : ‘Sides, wouldn’t all that shit about not bottling things up make you a hypocrite or whatever?
lines.zh: : 再说，你那套「别把事憋在心里」的说法，不也让你成了伪君子什么的？

lines.en: : That is, assuming you’re still capable of feeling anything and you’re not some...mindless fuck-robot.
lines.zh: : 前提是你还有感觉，而不是什么……没脑子的性爱机器人。

lines.en: : You know, at this point, that’s starting to sound like a pretty accurate description.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，到了这一步，这个描述听起来还挺准确的。

lines.en: if yumiknows == True:
: Remember who it is you’re talking to, asshole. The second I have {i}any{/i} confirmation you’re sticking your dick in anyone other than Chika, I’m tearing it all down.
lines.zh: : 记住你是在跟谁说话，混蛋。只要让我{i}确认{/i}你把鸡巴伸进了 Chika 以外的任何人身上，我就把一切全掀了。

lines.en: : You could start by finishing that wall. A few hundred more punches and you’ll have likely made some sort of chip in it.
lines.zh: : 你可以从砸完那堵墙开始。再打几百拳，你大概就能在上面敲出点缺口了。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound10
: {i}*Sniff*{/i}
: Why me, man?...
lines.zh: : 为什么是我啊，老兄？……

lines.en: : Why won’t everyone just leave me alone?...
lines.zh: : 为什么大家就不能别管我？……

lines.en: I highly doubt Yumi wants me to actually answer that question- which is good, because I’d have no answer for it if she did.
lines.zh: 我很怀疑 Yumi 是否真的想让我回答这个问题——这样也好，因为就算她想，我也答不上来。

lines.en: I can’t speak for anyone else, obviously, but why {i}do{/i} I keep bothering Yumi?
lines.zh: 别人我当然没法代表，但我为什么{i}总要{/i}去烦 Yumi？

lines.en: Is it {i}really{/i} just to have sex with her?
lines.zh: {i}真的{/i}只是为了跟她上床吗？

lines.en: Or is it more like I’m chasing after some sort of debt that I feel she’s owed after stealing her first kiss on a hill overlooking the homeless?
lines.zh: 还是说，我更像是在追讨某种我觉得欠她的债——自从在那片俯瞰流浪汉的山坡上偷走她的初吻之后？

lines.en: Or maybe it’s neither of those things?
lines.zh: 或者两者都不是？

lines.en: Or maybe it’s both?
lines.zh: 或者两者都是？

lines.en: Maybe I’m just doing this because I feel like I’m supposed to?
lines.zh: 也许我只是觉得自己该这么做？

lines.en: Like neglecting her will, one way or another, cause my life to spiral out of control into a marathon of meaningless sex acts with all of her classmates.
lines.zh: 就好像不管怎样，忽视她都会让我的人生失控，变成一场和她所有同学的无意义的性爱马拉松。

lines.en: That would have sounded wonderful several school years ago.
lines.zh: 要是在几个学年之前，这听起来会很美妙。

lines.en: Actually, it sounds wonderful right now.
lines.zh: 事实上，现在听起来也挺美妙的。

lines.en: But, strangely enough, the presence of a girl who just wants me to leave her alone somehow brings a little balance to this thing of mine resembling a life.
lines.zh: 但奇怪的是，一个只希望我离她远点的女孩的存在，竟给我这勉强称得上人生的人生带来了一点平衡。

lines.en: And I’m talking about someone who {i}actually{/i} wants me to leave them alone.
lines.zh: 我指的是一个{i}真的{/i}希望我别去烦她的人。

lines.en: Even that part of Maya’s personality has been beginning to show cracks as of late.
lines.zh: 就连 Maya 性格中的那一面，最近也开始出现裂痕了。

lines.en: But here’s Yumi- equipped with more cracks than you’d get from throwing a frag grenade at a china cabinet.
lines.zh: 可 Yumi 在这儿——她身上的裂痕，比朝瓷器柜扔一颗手雷炸出来的还多。

lines.en: And here’s me-
lines.zh: 而我在这儿——

lines.en: Desperate to “fix” her.
lines.zh: 拼命想要「修好」她。

lines.en: scene black
Yumi stands up and shakes her gloves off before bringing them to her eyes to wipe away her tears, because god forbid I actually {i}see{/i} them.
lines.zh: Yumi 站起身，抖了抖手套，然后把手套举到眼前擦掉眼泪——因为上天可不允许我真的{i}看见{/i}它们。

lines.en: She stands still for a moment, torn between thoughts of running away again or actually talking to me.
lines.zh: 她静静地站了一会儿，在「再次逃走」和「真的跟我说说话」之间犹豫。

lines.en: If she does run, I won’t chase her this time. I know better than to go out of my way for someone twice in rapid succession.
lines.zh: 如果她真跑了，这次我不会追。我还不至于在短时间内为同一个人破例两次。

lines.en: But-
lines.zh: 可是——

lines.en: If she wants to talk-
lines.zh: 如果她想谈——

lines.en: I’ll do my best to soak up whatever overly-aggressive behavior or excuse she has for me this time around.
lines.zh: 我会尽力承受她这次扔给我的任何过激言行或借口。

lines.en: All while reminding myself that I can’t touch her, no matter how much I may want to.
lines.zh: 同时不断提醒自己：不管我多想，我都不能碰她。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound11
: So...fliers? Really?
lines.zh: : 所以……发传单？真的？

lines.en: : This why you can’t be bothered to actually teach? You’re too busy workin’ night jobs with allegedly recovering addicts?
lines.zh: : 这就是你懒得真正教书的原因？你忙着跟那些据说正在戒毒的人打夜工？

lines.en: : Yes. I also fight crime by night, but you have to keep my secret identity to yourself or the two of us could be assassinated.
lines.zh: : 对。我晚上还打击犯罪，不过你得替我保密身份，不然我们俩可能会被暗杀。

lines.en: : Also, you should be thankful that I don’t actually teach because, if I did, you would have failed a long, long time ago.
lines.zh: : 还有，你该庆幸我其实不教书，因为我要是真教书，你早就挂科挂到八百年后了。

lines.en: : I’d be more interested in coming to school if I didn’t constantly feel like my teacher was imagining me naked.
lines.zh: : 要不是总感觉老师在想象我裸体的样子，我上课的兴趣会高很多。

lines.en: : Don’t flatter yourself, Yumi. I have a whole twenty girls to imagine naked now. I only have so much time for you.
lines.zh: : 别自作多情了，Yumi。我现在有整整二十个女孩可以想象裸体的样子。分给你的时间有限。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound12
: Ew! Gross! Fuck off!
lines.zh: : 呕！恶心！滚蛋！

lines.en: : See, this is exactly why I don’t show up! Because of you!
lines.zh: : 看吧，这就是我不来上课的原因！都是因为你！

lines.en: : Why not ask for a transfer then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不申请转班？

lines.en: : To where? Everyone thinks I’m a fucking delinquent, dude. No one wants me.
lines.zh: : 转到哪儿去？所有人都觉得我是个不良少女，老兄。没人想要我。

lines.en: : They don’t {i}think{/i} you’re a delinquent. You literally {i}are{/i} a delinquent.
lines.zh: : 他们不是{i}「觉得」{/i}你是不良少女。你本来{i}就是{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. That’s why they all think it. But that’s beside the point!
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。所以他们才那么想。但这不是重点！

lines.en: : I’m stuck in your stupid class, and unless you decide to throw me out of it, you’re stuck with me too.
lines.zh: : 我被困在你这个破班里，除非你把我踢出去，否则你也得一直忍着我。

lines.en: : Just...only on days when I actually show up. The rest of the time, just pretend I don’t exist or some shit.
lines.zh: : 只是……只有我真的来上课的那些天。其余时间，你就当我不存在什么的。

lines.en: : You know I can’t do that, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你知道我做不到，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound13
: But...why?
lines.zh: : 可……为什么？

lines.en: : All I do is cause problems and start shit with both you {i}and{/i} the other girls.
lines.zh: : 我只会制造麻烦，跟你{i}和{/i}其他女生吵架。

lines.en: : I’ve got what’s basically a negative attendance record, shit grades when I {i}do{/i} take tests and, to top it all off, I’ve got mad fucking dirt on you from when you kissed me.
lines.zh: : 我的出勤记录基本上是负的，{i}参加考试时{/i}成绩烂得一塌糊涂，更绝的是，我还握着你吻我那次的大把把柄。

lines.en: : Granted, nobody will fucking believe me if I tell them, but all of that should be enough for you to want to stay the fuck away.
lines.zh: : 虽说我说出去也没人会信，但光是这些，就足够让你想离我远远的了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : You just normally look a little...angrier when you say things like that.
lines.zh: : 你平时说这种话的时候，看起来……会更凶一点。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound14
: I’m done being angry for today.
lines.zh: : 我今天气不动了。

lines.en: : It’s giving me a headache.
lines.zh: : 气得我头疼。

lines.en: : I just want to go home and go to sleep.
lines.zh: : 我只想回家睡觉。

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound15
: What now?
lines.zh: : 又怎么了？

lines.en: : Is my sudden vulnerable side making you question your morals again?
lines.zh: : 我突然露出脆弱的一面，又让你开始质疑自己的道德了吗？

lines.en: : Are you going to make another horrible decision, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你打算再做一个糟糕的决定吗，老师？

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound16
: What if I close my eyes?
lines.zh: : 要是我闭上眼睛呢？

lines.en: : How about now?
lines.zh: : 那现在呢？

lines.en: : Are you thinking about what you could get away with?...
lines.zh: : 你在想自己能趁机干点什么吗？……

lines.en: : What sort of horrible shit you could do to me?...
lines.zh: : 在想能对我做出什么样可怕的事？……

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound17
: And how fucking easy it would be to overpower me when I’m so fucking weak right now!
lines.zh: : 还有，在我现在这么他妈虚弱的时候，制服我该有多他妈容易！

Something pulls me under so quickly that I can’t even get a glimpse at what it is.
lines.zh: 有什么东西以极快的速度把我拽了下去，我连它长什么样都没能看上一眼。

lines.en: But, if I had to take a guess, it would probably look something like me.
lines.zh: 不过要我猜的话，它大概长得有点像我。

lines.en: I don’t know whether or not I’m blacking out right now, and I fear that whenever I snap out of this, I might find myself in a similar place to somewhere I’ve been in the past.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己现在是不是在断片，我害怕的是，等我回过神来，可能会发现自己身处某个与过去相似的地方。

lines.en: I can only hope this isn’t true-
lines.zh: 我只能希望这不是真的——

lines.en: But given the fact that Yumi’s already had a bad streak of luck today-
lines.zh: 但考虑到 Yumi 今天已经倒了一整天的霉——

lines.en: And the {i}added{/i} fact that she’s been the target of these lapses in not just judgement but what seems like reality as a whole-
lines.zh: {i}再加上{/i}她一直是这些失误的靶心——不只是判断上的失误，而是整个「现实」的失误——

lines.en: Well-
lines.zh: 那么——

lines.en: I can only imagine how things must be-
lines.zh: 我只能想象事情会变成什么样——

scene yumiwallpound19
When I open my eyes, it’s as if nothing has changed at all.
lines.zh: 我睁开眼睛时，一切都仿佛没有发生过变化。

lines.en: Yumi is still standing there with tears pooling up behind her eyelids- though, several have managed to escape down the length of her cheeks.
lines.zh: Yumi 仍站在那儿，泪水在眼睑后蓄积——不过已经有几滴逃了出来，顺着她的脸颊滑下。

lines.en: And I’m still standing right next to her, caught somewhere between the early stages of forming an erection and the desire to slap her across the face and snap her out of whatever this is.
lines.zh: 我仍然站在她身边，卡在「刚开始勃起」和「想扇她一巴掌让她从这状态里醒过来」之间。

lines.en: Two slaps in one night might be a bit too much for her, though.
lines.zh: 不过一晚上挨两巴掌，对她来说可能有点太多了。

lines.en: And so I will use this moment as an excuse to reclaim several of the brownie points that I may have lost by being seen out in public with her least favorite person in the world.
lines.zh: 所以我要利用这一刻，把因为和她世上最讨厌的人一起出现在公共场合而丢掉的印象分挽回一些。

: O-Obviously not! In fact, I’m surprised you were able to hold back given how fucking...perverted and...insatiable you are!
lines.zh: : 当、当然不是！事实上，你他妈那么……变态又……欲求不满，我倒很意外你居然忍住了！

lines.en: scene yumiwallpound22
: Jesus! When the fuck did it get so dark out here?! What time even is it right now?!
lines.zh: : 天哪！外面什么时候他妈这么黑了？！现在到底几点了？！

lines.en: : Listen, as much as I’d love to stay and chat, I’ve got shit to do and...and it’s a long walk home.
lines.zh: : 听着，虽然我很想留下来继续聊，但我还有事要做，而且……而且回家路挺远的。

lines.en: : We can walk together if you want?...
lines.zh: : 你愿意的话，我们可以一起走？……

: No.
: I’ll make it on my own.
lines.zh: : 我自己能回去。

lines.en: scene black
Yumi leaves with that, and I’m forced to stand there in the alleyway and wait for her to fade away from my sight so as to not awkwardly walk behind her since we have to go in the same direction.
lines.zh: Yumi 说完就走了，我被迫站在小巷里，等她从我的视线中消失，免得尴尬地跟在她后面——毕竟我们要走同一个方向。

lines.en: I’m not sure what really came over her with that “test” of hers a few minutes ago, but I’m thankful that it didn’t end in tragedy when nearly everything else tonight did.
lines.zh: 我不确定她几分钟前那个「测试」到底是中了什么邪，但我很庆幸，在今晚几乎所有其他事都以悲剧收场时，它至少没有。

lines.en: I guess there’s nothing left to do now but...go home, then.
lines.zh: 我想现在也没别的事可做了，只能……回家吧。

lines.en: I decide to send Yuki a text on my way out of the alley, confirming that her daughter is, at least as of several minutes ago, still alive and doing mostly okay.
lines.zh: 走出小巷时，我决定给 Yuki 发条短信，确认她女儿至少在几分钟前还活着，大体上也还好。

lines.en: Yuki doesn’t respond.
lines.zh: Yuki 没有回复。

lines.en: I catch a bus back home and go the rest of the night without saying or thinking anything else.
lines.zh: 我搭公交回了家，剩下的这一夜什么也没说，什么也没想。
